# dsh-theme-matrix-glass
A DeepSeek Harness (dsh) theme plugin: Matrix-style **binary digital rain** (`0` and `1` only) plus
a **frosted-glass** token layer. Digits spawn only while a task is running; when the task stops, spa
wning stops, the digits already on screen keep falling until they leave the bottom, and the canvas i
s, the digits already on screen keep falling until they leave the bottom, and the canvas is cleared.
DeepSeek Harness（dsh）主题插件：黑客帝国式 **二进制数字雨**（字形只有 `0` 和 `1`）＋ **磨砂玻璃** token 层。只有任务运行时才生成数字；任务停止后停止生成，
已在屏幕上的数字继续下落到离开画面底部，然后画布清空。
## What it does / 功能
| Behaviour | Detail |
| Binary rain gated by activity | Columns of `0`/`1` spawn only while a session reports `running: tr
ue`. Source: the session snapshot each surface receives (`byId[sessionId].running`, `current` sessio

n preferred). |
| Falls out, then blank | Stopping the gate stops spawning; live columns keep fallin
g until `y - tail·lineHeight` passes the bottom edge, then the canvas is cleared (`clearRect`) and t

he `requestAnimationFrame` loop is cancelled. An idle screen costs nothing. |
| Low digit opacity |
Default `0.10`, adjustable `0.02–0.28`. Only the head glyph of a column is brighter (global alpha ca

pped at 1.0); tail glyphs fade as `pow(1 - i/tail, 1.7)`. |
| Same look in light and dark | Light an
d dark need different ink, not just a different blend mode: `multiply` keeps only what is darker tha
n the backdrop, so the bright green that glows on black is close to the paper on a near-white page.
Light mode therefore draws a deeper green (`hsl(140, 74–88%, 26–46%)`) and applies a `1.7×` alpha ga
in, so one opacity setting reads the same in both appearances. The active scheme is read from `body[
data-ds-dark-theme]` and followed live through a `MutationObserver`, so switching appearance repaint

s immediately. |
| Frosted glass via theme tokens | A layer written through `theme.overrideTokens()`
on the alias surface tokens (`bg-layer-1`, `bg-layer-2`, `bg-overlay`, `specific-sidebar-fill`), th
e border tokens, brand and label tokens. Translucent surfaces + green hairline borders. The document
ed `--dsw-menu-backdrop-filter` token is also set so menus blur; if a dsh line has no such token the

call is skipped and the rest still applies. |
| Registered theme id | `theme.register({ id: 'matrix
-glass', colorScheme: 'dark', … })`. The plugin never calls `setTheme()`: the layer sits on top of w

hatever light / dark / system appearance is already active. |
| Live configuration surface | A confi
guration card on this bundle's Plugin Manager page (`plugins.bundle.config` seat). Values persist in
`localStorage` under `dsh-theme-matrix-glass:v1`. |
## Where it renders / 渲染位置
- Rain canvas: `shell.overlay` — the frame-wide, click-through layer (`inset: 0`). The canvas uses `
position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: -1; pointer-events: none`, with `mix-blend-mode: screen` in dark
mode and `multiply` in light mode, so low-alpha digits do not dim body text. The digit ink and alph
a gain differ per scheme (see the table above), because the same bright green is unreadable on white

.
- Settings card: `plugins.bundle.config`, keyed by the package name; renders `null` for the `summa
ngs card: `plugins.bundle.config`, keyed by the package name; renders `null` for the `summary` view.

## Install / 安装
Plugin market: **设置 → 插件 → 插件市场 → 主题（Themes）**, then install `dsh-theme-matrix-glass`.
From a repository:

From npm, once published:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
From a local checkout: point the Plugin Manager installer at the folder holding this `package.json`.
After installing, reload the page so the browser half loads.
## Uninstall / 卸载
设置 → 插件 → 本插件 → 关闭或卸载。The stylesheet, both token layers, the slot registrations, the animation loop
and every listener are registered inside `ctx.effect`, so unloading removes all of them. The plugin
never rewrites your appearance preference, so the UI returns to the previous light / dark choice.
## Repo layout / 目录
| Path | Purpose |
| `package.json` | declares `dsh.bundle.patch` (what makes it installable) and the `dsh.client` web

half |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | one `insert` row mounting the Host entry and the Client half |
| `inde

x.js` | Host half: intentionally empty — every behaviour is browser-side |
| `client.js` | rain engi

ne, activity gate, token layers, configuration card, locale dictionary |
| `locale/zh.json`, `locale

/en.json` | package metadata shown in the plugin list |
| `icon.svg` | card icon inside the Harness

plugin manager |
| `assets/icon-market.png` | 192×192 raster tile for market storefronts (the entry

`icon:` field) |
| `tools/make-market-icon.py` | regenerates that PNG (Pillow) |
## Notes / 说明
- Animation is throttled to ~30 fps, pauses while the tab is hidden, and reduces column count and fa

ll speed under `prefers-reduced-motion`.
- Glyphs come from a small integer hash (`hash32(col.id, i,
floor(now/220)) & 1`), so a column flickers between `0` and `1` the way the reference effect does,

without a random allocation per frame.
- No shell access, no network requests, no tool registration,
no writes to session data.
